<thought>We need to retrieve polymorph data for a diverse set of nitride compositions, respecting the limits: max_energy_above_hull 0.3, max_per_composition 3, and up to 40 compositions. We'll use the batch_retrieve_polymorphs tool with a list of nitride formulas (under 40). This will create individual JSON files in a directory. Then we will consolidate them into a single dataset using consolidate_polymorph_datasets and output the path to the final JSON file.</thought>
<action>batch_retrieve_polymorphs</action>
<action_input>{
    "compositions": [
        "TiN", "VN", "ZrN", "HfN", "CrN", "MoN", "NbN", "TaN",
        "AlN", "GaN", "InN", "Si3N4", "BN", "Mg3N2", "Ca3N2",
        "Sr3N2", "Ba3N2", "LaN", "CeN", "PrN", "NdN", "SmN",
        "EuN", "GdN", "TbN", "DyN", "HoN", "ErN", "TmN",
        "YbN", "LuN", "ScN", "YN", "Zn3N2", "Cd3N2", "Pb3N2",
        "Bi3N2", "FeN", "CoN"
    ],
    "max_energy_above_hull": 0.3,
    "max_per_composition": 3,
    "save_directory": "nitride_polymorphs"
}</action_input>
